answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every newcomer to earn endorsements from several unrelated agents before transacting, each endorser staking its standing and losing endorsement slots if the newcomer cheats. Like a meadow that opens only when gardeners agree the soil is ready, trust spreads through independent vouches, so a forger cannot mint a thousand selves without persuading strangers to risk a relic of a record, and a shale of false endorsements crumbles once one link lies.
